II. Some women are painters.

Conclusion II: Some women are painters → False (This is possible but not definite)

questions.question: Six friends P, Q, R, S, T and U are sitting at a circular table facing the centre. S is sitting third to the left of T. R is not sitting between T and U. Arranging them according to the given information,

S is sitting third to the left of T. Q is seated second to the right of T.

‘S’ is sitting between U and Q.

Hence, “S” is the correct answer.
